entries.name: Carapace of Patience
entries.flavor: It never strikes back. It simply outlasts whatever struck first.

entries.name: Pop Rhythm Baton
entries.flavor: A polished, neon-coated conductor's baton that pulses with the rhythm of a stadium anthem, guiding the dance of the dead.

entries.name: Matryoshka Shell
entries.flavor: A series of nested, hand-carved wooden layers that pulse with a hollow, rhythmic thud.

entries.name: Matryoshka Exclamation
entries.flavor: A series of nested, silver-plated shells that expand outward with a sharp, metallic crack.

entries.name: Corporate Ice-Maker
entries.flavor: A heavy, industrial-grade metal canister shaped like a sled, perpetually emitting a freezing mist.

entries.name: Spring-Loaded Pole
entries.flavor: A long, flexible shaft of petrified wood bound with sinew, designed to launch the wielder forward with sudden, violent momentum.

entries.name: Terracotta Canopy
entries.flavor: A heavy ceramic tile, shaped like a miniature roof, sheltering a cluster of thick vines.

entries.name: Bulwarked Shell
entries.flavor: A thick, woody shell that absorbs the impact of the world.

entries.name: Iron-Capped Hollow
entries.flavor: A dented, heavy iron dome that has lost its luster, containing nothing but the echoes of failed strikes.

entries.name: Spiked Nut-Hull Chassis
entries.flavor: A dense, jagged shell of reinforced nut-matter, bristling with iron-hard thorns and smelling of heavy grease.

entries.name: Hand of the Great Banner
entries.flavor: A large, tattered flag held tightly in a skeletal hand, cherished in secret by the undead.

entries.name: Spike-Husk Relic
entries.flavor: A jagged, calcified shard of dried skin that feels like walking on broken earth.

entries.name: Verdant Canopy
entries.flavor: A woven lattice of thick, fibrous vines and hardened pumpkin rinds, shaped like a protective roof to shelter those beneath.

entries.name: The Maw's Completion
entries.flavor: A heavy, circular ring of polished bone and sun-bleached keratin, shaped like a wide, unhinged jaw that has finally snapped shut.

entries.name: Cracked Nut Husk
entries.flavor: A hand-carved, jagged shell that leaks vital essence through its fissures.

entries.name: 平安果
entries.flavor: A polished, jade-like fruit carved from solid emerald, pulsing with a soft, protective light that wards off misfortune.

entries.name: Signal Beacon of the Iron Bastion
entries.flavor: A heavy, rotating prism of reinforced tungsten, pulsing with a rhythmic amber light that cuts through the smoke of war.

entries.name: Scrap-Heap Sentry
entries.flavor: A jagged, unyielding mass of salvaged plating and calcified bone, welded together to form a protective shell that refuses to decay.

entries.name: Cinder-Husk Reliquary
entries.flavor: A hollowed bamboo vessel filled with smoldering ash and the restless spirits of the fallen.

entries.name: Axis of the Unyielding Nut
entries.flavor: A heavy, geometric nut forged from compressed tectonic plates, its surface etched with a singular, unbreaking vector.

entries.name: Vined-Cherry Husk
entries.flavor: A protective shell of hardened pumpkin rind, woven with sweet cherry vines to bolster the resilience of all allies.

entries.name: Edgar's Cold Specimen
entries.flavor: A heavy, pressurized glass canister containing a dark, coagulated sludge that pulses with a rhythmic, mechanical thud.

entries.name: The Black Olive Sentinel
entries.flavor: A heavy, polished obsidian sphere wrapped in thick, protective leather straps, resembling a ceremonial ball used to guard the elite.

entries.name: Medal of Unwavering Allegiance
entries.flavor: A heavy, polished obsidian disc engraved with the faces of loyal subordinates, presented during ceremonies to honor those who never falter.

entries.name: Spore-Drift Vessel
entries.flavor: A lightweight, porous ceramic pot woven with living vines, designed to release nutrient-rich pollen into the wind.

entries.name: Edgar's Parade
entries.flavor: A polished, ceremonial baton made of fossilized bone and silver, used to direct the rhythmic march of the undead.

entries.name: 托付之翼
entries.flavor: 由精密的航空合金与加固的补救组件构成的飞行器残骸，承载着对最后生机的托付。

entries.name: Plunge-Stolen Tether
entries.flavor: A frayed, bungee-like cord made of grave-dirt and stolen silk, dangling from a heavy, plummeting stone.

entries.name: Cabbage Sky-Drop
entries.flavor: A cluster of tightly wound, leafy spheres suspended in mid-air, ready to be hurled downward to provide support.

entries.name: Cabbage Wrap
entries.flavor: A tightly layered, leafy vessel that accelerates the rhythm of growth.

entries.name: Spore-Base Launcher
entries.flavor: A dense, layered cabbage core mounted upon a sturdy mushroom pedestal, designed to propel spores with rhythmic precision.

entries.name: Thorned Gourd
entries.flavor: A dense, swollen vessel of organic matter, its surface is densely populated with sharp, rigid needles that protrude from every seam.

entries.name: Nut-Shell Pot
entries.flavor: A heavy, ceramic vessel reinforced with thick, unyielding nut-shells, designed to anchor its contents firmly to the earth.

entries.name: Pitted Nectar Core
entries.flavor: A viscous, deep-crimson mass of congealed syrup encased in a bruised, hard shell that drips thick, sticky nectar.

entries.name: Magnetic Husk Drone
entries.flavor: A pulsating, magnetic pumpkin shell that orbits the commander, acting as a necrotic decoy for the swarm.

entries.name: Cherry Canopy
entries.flavor: A translucent, petal-shaped dome of hardened nectar that expands to deflect incoming strikes.

entries.name: The Lurking Gourd
entries.flavor: A heavy, hollowed-out vessel of fibrous rind that seems to pulse with a hunger for the very ground it rests upon.

entries.name: Rhythmic Pole-Vaulting Grace
entries.flavor: A polished, elongated bamboo pole wrapped in fine silk, vibrating with the echo of a thousand perfect performances.

entries.name: Spore-Graft Reliquary
entries.flavor: A calcified, bulbous seed pod woven from necrotic vines and hardened sap, pulsing with the concentrated essence of those who fell to feed the bloom.

entries.name: The Surgeon's Tail
entries.flavor: A jagged, iridescent mermaid tail crafted from calcified medical instruments and sea-foam, pulsing with a rhythmic, angry red glow as if searching for a way back to the deep.

entries.name: Forged Husk
entries.flavor: A heavy, rusted iron plate fused into a fungal mass, designed to absorb the impact of destruction.

entries.name: Unfinished Choreography
entries.flavor: A collection of mismatched, polished engine parts and rhythmic scrap metal that seems to twitch with a restless, dancing energy.

entries.name: Trident of the New Vanguard
entries.flavor: A polished brass helm fused to a three-pronged spear, symbolizing the shared path of the legion.

entries.name: Trident's Ocular Cycle
entries.flavor: A rusted, three-pronged relic dripping with viscous saline, ensuring the tide always turns in a new cycle of protection.

entries.name: Trident of the Bloated Scion
entries.flavor: A heavy, rusted three-pronged relic forged from the calcified fat and marrow of ancient giants, pulsing with the hunger of a thousand dead lineages.

entries.name: The Necro-Traveler's Itinerary
entries.flavor: A translucent, preserved slab of zombie sinew, etched with a map of inevitable destinations.

entries.name: Kinship of the Hollowed
entries.flavor: A heavy, rusted iron plate shaped like a clenched fist, containing the preserved, unblinking eye of a fallen comrade to ensure the unit never fights alone.

entries.name: 研究所选拔样本
entries.flavor: 由研究所精心培育的仙人掌纤维编织而成，其尖锐的刺状结构象征着被选中的优秀个体。

entries.name: Crimson Lotus of Betrayal
entries.flavor: A blooming, blood-red lotus forged from the calcified remains of traitors, pulsing with an inexhaustible, necrotic heat.

entries.name: The Unformed Vessel
entries.flavor: A shifting mass of raw, unformed loam and primordial silt that mimics the shape of a vessel without ever truly becoming one.

entries.name: Primordial Silt
entries.flavor: A heavy, featureless mound of shifting loam that absorbs the impact of reality.

entries.name: Cracked Ember Shell
entries.flavor: A hard, toasted husk that yields a burst of intense heat upon impact.

entries.name: 萤火阳光菇·萤光璀璨
entries.flavor: A translucent, bioluminescent fungal cap that pulses with a warm, rhythmic glow, housing a symbiotic swarm of tiny, light-emitting spores.

entries.name: Symbiotic Spore-Light
entries.flavor: A translucent, bioluminescent fungal cluster that pulses in rhythm with the heartbeat of those nearby, weaving threads of light between living things.

entries.name: Luminescent Symbiote
entries.flavor: A cluster of translucent, glowing fungal filaments that pulse in rhythm with the life force of those nearby.

entries.name: The Gridiron Helm
entries.flavor: A heavy, dented helmet forged from sea-salt iron and reinforced with thick rubber, shaped like a crashing wave to ensure the squad stays in the flow of the play.

entries.name: Garlic-Pumpkin Bulb
entries.flavor: A heavy, bulbous gourd with thick, pungent skin that smells of sharp cloves and earthy rot.

entries.name: Unified Garlic Vanguard
entries.flavor: A dense, bulbous mass of pungent, overlapping skins that forms an unbreakable front-line barrier.

entries.name: Cherry-Pie Guarantee
entries.flavor: A heavy, ceramic dish filled with thick, red filling that smells of a garden in bloom; it ensures the contents remain as solid as a tombstone.

entries.name: Gilded Frost-Cap
entries.flavor: A heavy, metallic mushroom cap forged from solid gold and encased in eternal permafrost, providing an unyielding anchor for the battlefield.

entries.name: Gilded Nut Shell
entries.flavor: A dense, metallic husk that absorbs impact and mends the spirit.

entries.name: Solar Sower
entries.flavor: A heavy, golden vessel shaped like a blooming sunflower, designed to store concentrated sunlight and release it as pure energy.

entries.name: Rooted Graft
entries.flavor: A dense, calcified knot of vine and ironwood that feels less like an object and more like a piece of the forest's own skeleton.

entries.name: Perfectly Disappeared Chili
entries.flavor: A flawless, translucent chili pepper made of solidified spice, appearing to flicker in and out of existence as if it were never truly there.

entries.name: Vessel of the Unliving Bloom
entries.flavor: A heavy, cracked ceramic pot containing a tangled mass of necrotic roots and pale, blooming flowers that pulse with a rhythmic, hungry light.

entries.name: Emperor's Spore-Casket
entries.flavor: A calcified, pulsating fungal mass shaped like a miniature imperial crown, containing the preserved essence of a zombie sub-species.

entries.name: Glacial Ossuary
entries.flavor: A jagged, frost-rimed shard of bone that radiates a bone-chilling aura, hardening the very essence of those who carry it.

entries.name: Frost-Cracked Shell
entries.flavor: A dense, frozen kernel that shatters into jagged shards upon impact.

entries.name: Frost-Bloom Linkage
entries.flavor: A crystalline petal forged from frozen nectar, pulsing with the rhythm of a winter garden.

entries.name: Frost-Swell Spore
entries.flavor: A bloated, translucent fungal mass that pulses with freezing vapors, rhythmically expanding and contracting as it draws moisture from the air.

entries.name: Mimicry Card
entries.flavor: A pressed botanical specimen encased in a thin, translucent card that shifts its cellular structure to match the surrounding flora.

entries.name: Propeller Nut
entries.flavor: A heavy, spinning metal nut that hums with a constant, mindless chatter.

entries.name: 银灰色之物
entries.flavor: A silver-grey, uncomprehending mass of scavenged debris that hungrily absorbs the essence of the fallen.

entries.name: Iron-Cask Husk
entries.flavor: A heavy, reinforced metal lid bolted onto a decaying melon core, serving as a sturdy base for relentless momentum.

entries.name: Ironnut Shell
entries.flavor: A heavy, seamless sphere of cold-forged iron, shaped like a massive nut that refuses to crack.

entries.name: 不锈钢意志
entries.flavor: 全副武装的金属外壳反射着冰冷的光芒，这种坚不可摧的信心让僵尸在冲锋时显得无懈可击。

entries.name: Ferrous Gourd
entries.flavor: A heavy, metallic pumpkin shell that exerts a magnetic pull on nearby debris.

entries.name: Legacy of the Iron King
entries.flavor: A rusted, oversized gear from a predecessor's chassis, etched with the blueprints of a fallen empire.

entries.name: The Gilded Effigy
entries.flavor: A hollow, brightly painted wooden shell, stuffed with coarse straw and hidden iron nails, waiting to endure the blow.

entries.name: Fragmented Bloom
entries.flavor: A cluster of porcelain doll limbs fused with thorny vines, held together by a core of volatile, blooming gunpowder.

entries.name: Magnetic Patchwork Gourd
entries.flavor: A heavy, stitched pumpkin shell filled with volatile magnetic filings and explosive stuffing.

entries.name: Verdant Husk
entries.flavor: A buoyant, fibrous shell woven from aquatic reeds and hardened by river silt, designed to absorb the impact of the current.

entries.name: Kirov's Product Line
entries.flavor: A collection of mass-produced, hollowed-out drone shells that twitch with a lingering, necrotic energy.

entries.name: Luminous Magnetite Spore
entries.flavor: A pulsating, translucent fungal core encased in a swirling magnetic ore that pulls in stray light particles.

entries.name: Luminous Husk Lantern
entries.flavor: A hollowed, translucent nut shell containing a flickering, undead spark that radiates a soothing, pale glow.

entries.name: Luminous Gourd Lantern
entries.flavor: A hollowed, glowing vegetable vessel that radiates a soft warmth to protect those nearby.

entries.name: Stellar Starfruit
entries.flavor: A translucent, star-shaped carving of celestial glass that pulses with a soft, rhythmic glow, as if capturing the essence of a distant nebula.

entries.name: Spore-Spore Parasite
entries.flavor: A cluster of translucent, bioluminescent fungal caps that pulse with a rhythmic, sickly green light, occasionally ejecting sharp, necrotic spores from their undersides.

entries.name: Lotus Root Siphon
entries.flavor: A translucent, fibrous bulb carved from petrified lily stems, pulsing with nutrient-rich sap.

entries.name: Zephyr's Clover
entries.flavor: A translucent, four-leafed charm woven from solidified gusts and captured sunlight, spinning perpetually in a phantom breeze.

entries.name: Edgar's Grand Pilotage
entries.flavor: A polished, chrome-plated cockpit module etched with the schematics of a great era, pulsing with the steady rhythm of a pilot's heartbeat.

entries.name: Trifoliate Magnet
entries.flavor: A heavy, three-lobed clover forged from dark iron and pulsing with magnetic currents, designed to pull vitality from the very air to feed its master.

entries.name: Magnetic Skull-Cap
entries.flavor: A heavy, magnetized iron helmet shaped like a hollowed skull, designed to pull projectiles toward the wearer's head to absorb the impact.

entries.name: Sky-High Watermelon Launcher
entries.flavor: A buoyant, hollowed-out melon shell suspended in mid-air, designed to launch refreshing seeds at allies.

entries.name: Rind-Shell Counter
entries.flavor: A thick, segmented watermelon rind that hardens upon impact, releasing a spray of sweet juice to coat the user in a protective layer.

entries.name: Frost-Bound Muster
entries.flavor: A heavy iron standard, encrusted with thick layers of permafrost and bone-dust, used to signal the advance of the frozen legions.

entries.name: Spore-Fused Tuber
entries.flavor: A dense, pulsating mass of intertwined root fibers and starch, constantly absorbing nutrients from the soil to reinforce its structure.

entries.name: Gilded Carapace
entries.flavor: A heavy, ornate plate of polished jade and gold, layered over thick, petrified skin to ensure even the most polite guest cannot leave a dent.

entries.name: 三叶坚果悬浮护身符
entries.flavor: A cluster of three polished nut-shells that orbit the commander in a slow, rhythmic dance, emitting a faint hum of protection.

entries.name: 坚果大蘑菇
entries.flavor: A heavy, nut-encased fungal cap that serves as a sturdy shield for the collective.

entries.name: Ceramic Hearth
entries.flavor: A thick-walled, unglazed earthenware vessel that absorbs heat to protect the life within.

entries.name: Hardened Nut-Gourd Shell
entries.flavor: A dense, multi-layered casing of petrified pumpkin rind and compressed nut-meat, providing a stubborn defense for those who endure.

entries.name: Obsidian Capsaicin Core
entries.flavor: A jagged, frozen chili pod encased in volcanic glass that radiates a searing, frost-bitten heat.

entries.name: 玄钢地刺王
entries.flavor: A heavy, jagged spike of dark, reinforced steel that pulses with the weight of a monarch's command.

entries.name: 下界合金铆钉
entries.flavor: A heavy, gleaming slab of Netherite-infused alloy, forged into a jagged, industrial shape that pulses with a dull, dark light.

entries.name: Magnetic Sieve
entries.flavor: A heavy, magnetized iron shell shaped like a hollowed pumpkin, pulsing with the residue of a grave-digging spirit.

entries.name: 松木暖炉
entries.flavor: A hollowed pine log containing a glowing ember, radiating warmth to stave off the biting frost.

entries.name: Pole-Vaulting Gridiron
entries.flavor: A rigid, splintered pole wrapped in stitched leather, used by the undead to launch themselves into the fray.

entries.name: Singularity Base
entries.flavor: A heavy, pulsating pedestal of compressed dark matter that warps the space around it, allowing projectiles to flicker in and out of existence.

entries.name: Spore-Cloud Sprout
entries.flavor: A cluster of damp, pulsating tubers that continuously release a fine, fertile mist from their caps.

entries.name: Nut-Shell Cap
entries.flavor: A tiny, hardened mushroom cap made of dense, nut-like shell material that provides a sturdy layer of protection.

entries.name: Mycelium Mantle
entries.flavor: A dense, overlapping cluster of thick-capped mushrooms that forms a spongy, protective layer around the commander.

entries.name: The Gilded Vessel
entries.flavor: A hollowed pumpkin carved into a heavy, ornate container, acting as a central anchor for the battlefield.

entries.name: Sovereign's Relic
entries.flavor: A weathered jade tablet containing the calcified remains of a fallen emperor, resting in a corner of the world long forgotten by time.

entries.name: Paper Bag Sentinel
entries.flavor: A fragile paper bag, held with extreme care, becomes a vessel for the unknown.

entries.name: Iridescent Sludge
entries.flavor: A shifting, gelatinous mass of semi-translucent sludge that pulses with a rhythmic, neon glow, undulating like spilled oil on water.

entries.name: Echoing Mic-Stand
entries.flavor: A silver-plated microphone mounted on a tripod of bleached bone, vibrating with the rhythm of a thousand phantom dancers.

entries.name: Sprout-Hearted Reliquary
entries.flavor: A trembling, translucent mushroom cap encased in a protective glass sphere, pulsing with a soft, rhythmic light that mimics a nervous heartbeat.

entries.name: Mimic's Trembling Spore
entries.flavor: A floating, translucent fungal bulb that shivers rhythmically, its surface rippling to mimic the surrounding terrain while it desperately seeks cover.

entries.name: Spore-Burst Buddy
entries.flavor: A cluster of plump, glowing mushrooms encased in a translucent, gelatinous sphere that pulses with rhythmic energy.

entries.name: Encouraging Vine-Heart
entries.flavor: A soft, pulsating pumpkin vine wrapped around a glowing seed, designed to bolster the courage of the timid.

entries.name: Sprouting Thunder-Tuber
entries.flavor: A heavy, damp tuber that pulses with static electricity, swelling in size as it absorbs moisture.

entries.name: Hydrated Husk
entries.flavor: A swollen, water-logged nut shell that pulses with a slow, necrotic rhythm.

entries.name: Mycelial Patchwork
entries.flavor: A tangled knot of glowing orange fungal threads and dried pumpkin rind, woven together to seal cracks in reality.

entries.name: Hydro-Gourd Vessel
entries.flavor: A translucent, bulbous container made of thick, water-logged gourd skin, pulsing with a rhythmic aquatic swell.

entries.name: Spore-Bloom Sprout
entries.flavor: A translucent, water-filled bulb containing sun-drenched mycelium that expands rapidly when exposed to light.

entries.name: Steel-Leaf Bamboo Barrier
entries.flavor: A dense, layered formation of sharpened steel-leaf bamboo shoots that interlock to form a resilient, unyielding barricade.

entries.name: Steel-Leaf Crucible
entries.flavor: A heavy, iron-forged vessel shaped like a budding pinecone, filled with razor-sharp metallic foliage that drinks in the heat of battle.

entries.name: Silvered Nut Shell
entries.flavor: A heavy, polished silver casing that feels impossibly dense and unyielding to the touch.

entries.name: Spore-Shield Canopy
entries.flavor: A heavy, fibrous dome of compressed fungal matter and broad leaves, designed to deflect incoming strikes and release a cloud of repelling spores from its thick base.

entries.name: Adventurer's Frozen Scar
entries.flavor: A jagged shard of permafrost, etched with the uneven, frozen ridges of a survivor's many wounds.

entries.name: Champion's Frozen Bulwark
entries.flavor: A heavy, frost-rimed shield forged from the remains of a thousand snow battles, held by those who refuse to yield the throne.

entries.name: Solaris Chrysalis
entries.flavor: A shifting, translucent petal forged from solidified sunlight and nectar, constantly reconfiguring its geometry to catch the zenith.

entries.name: Solaris Terracotta
entries.flavor: A heavy, sun-baked ceramic vessel that pulses with stored thermal energy, ready to release its life-giving warmth.

entries.name: Embers of the Hearth-Stump
entries.flavor: A charred, hollowed stump that pulses with a rhythmic, glowing heat, constantly shedding sparks that nourish the soil.

entries.name: Squashed Sentiment
entries.flavor: A flattened, pulpy mass of vegetable matter and spirit, pressed thin by the weight of a thousand footsteps, yet still radiating a warmth that moves the heart.

entries.name: Star-Fruit Companion
entries.flavor: A sun-drenched carving of star-shaped fruit nestled in a bed of thick, golden grass, symbolizing a bond that thrives in the light.

entries.name: Sand-Bound Ensemble
entries.flavor: A collection of small, grit-covered stone figurines, bundled tightly in coarse linen, performing a rhythmic, jerky dance.

entries.name: Edgar's Propelled Auger
entries.flavor: A rusted, heavy propeller shaft encased in a pressurized missile casing, constantly vibrating with an uncontrollable urge to breach the surface.

entries.name: Bouncy Spore-Husk
entries.flavor: A gelatinous, springy fungal mass that pulses with a rhythmic, undead energy, ready to bounce back from the brink.

entries.name: Solar Forge Spore
entries.flavor: A heavy, molten iron casing that pulses with captured sunlight, converting raw heat into structural integrity.

entries.name: Sun-Soaked Nut Shell
entries.flavor: A heavy, sun-warmed nut casing that radiates a gentle heat, providing a sturdy layer of protection to those nearby.

entries.name: Terracotta Sun-Vessel
entries.flavor: A heavy, unglazed ceramic pot that radiates a gentle warmth, constantly nurturing the soil within.

entries.name: Confident Spore-Shell
entries.flavor: A hollowed, sun-baked gourd shell that pulses with a rhythmic, defiant glow, ready to burst upon the battlefield.

entries.name: Eternal Nut-Shell Bastion
entries.flavor: A dense, obsidian-hued nut casing that has been polished by the relentless friction of day and night, serving as a rallying point for the legion.

entries.name: Edgar's Heavy-Duty Procurement
entries.flavor: A heavy, ball-shaped iron weight, wrapped in thick, protective leather and studded with brass rivets, looking more like a piece of sports equipment than a military relic.

entries.name: Viscous Grave-Oil Signet
entries.flavor: A heavy, translucent vessel of congealed grease and necrotic sludge, shifting with a life of its own.

entries.name: Sled-Runner's Ignition
entries.flavor: A polished, heavy iron runner shaped like a sled blade, perpetually vibrating with the kinetic energy of a sudden start.

entries.name: 脱下的中世纪盔甲
entries.flavor: A heavy, rusted breastplate stripped from a fallen knight, smelling of ancient earth and old battles.

entries.name: 帝果之重
entries.flavor: A heavy, spherical core of petrified fruit, wrapped in necrotic sinew that pulses with a dim, rhythmic heat.

entries.name: Nut-Clad Spike
entries.flavor: A jagged, heavy implement forged from hardened nut-shells and rusted iron, designed to anchor the user to the earth through sheer, unyielding weight.

entries.name: Edgar's Cockpit
entries.flavor: A reinforced, pressurized capsule salvaged from a fallen pilot, still humming with the residual energy of a high-output emitter.

entries.name: Assembly Card
entries.flavor: A heavy, metallic slab etched with circuit patterns that hums with kinetic energy.

entries.name: Magnetic Star-Core
entries.flavor: A heavy, pulsating sphere of magnetized star-matter that hums with the weight of the earth and the brilliance of a dying sun.

entries.name: Corporate Diver's Chronometer
entries.flavor: A polished brass stopwatch encased in reinforced diving glass, ticking with the relentless efficiency of a corporate deadline.

entries.name: Cinder-Soul Reliquary
entries.flavor: A hollowed phoenix feather encased in molten glass, pulsing with the heat of a dying star.

entries.name: 高坚果壳
entries.flavor: A dense, towering shell of hardened nut-matter, offering a satisfyingly crunchy texture to those who strike it.

entries.name: Frost-Bitten Brotherhood
entries.flavor: A jagged, frozen nut-shell encased in a layer of permafrost, pulsing with a volatile, angry heat.

entries.name: Edgar's Frozen World
entries.flavor: A jagged, translucent sphere of permafrost that contains swirling, contradictory whispers of a thousand lost civilizations.

entries.name: Steel-Nut Aegis
entries.flavor: A heavy, polished sphere of reinforced nut-shell and cold iron, shaped like a dense, unyielding fortress.

entries.name: Rugby Nut Shell
entries.flavor: A heavy, oval-shaped nut casing reinforced with thick, leathery skin, designed to absorb impact like a player in a scrum.

entries.name: Whirling Steel-Leaf Spindle
entries.flavor: A cluster of razor-sharp steel leaves mounted on a central axis, spinning with such velocity that they blur into a shimmering, cutting disc.

entries.name: Three-Line Scars
entries.flavor: A jagged, triple-stitched gourd shell, stained with dried ichor and bound by necrotic twine.

entries.name: Convergent Ember-Gourd
entries.flavor: A hollowed, translucent pumpkin shell containing swirling, concentrated solar flares that coalesce into a singular, blinding point of light.

entries.name: Sprouting Ember-Spud
entries.flavor: A heavy, starch-rich tuber that pulses with an inner heat, occasionally ejecting glowing pea-sized embers from its skin.

entries.name: Sower of the Ossuary
entries.flavor: A heavy, rectangular slab of porous granite, etched with weeping runes and perpetually leaking nutrient-rich, dark loam from its cracks.

entries.name: Rooted Bloom
entries.flavor: A heavy, water-logged lotus bulb encased in a glass terrarium, its roots spreading deep into the commander's mantle.

entries.name: Verdant Cipher
entries.flavor: A tangled knot of bioluminescent vines that pulses with rhythmic light, revealing hidden patterns in the soil.

entries.name: Gorging Maw
entries.flavor: A pulsating, translucent sac of digestive enzymes and jagged teeth, perpetually twitching as if tasting the air for its next meal.

entries.name: Accelerated Spore-Link
entries.flavor: A spinning, multi-lobed seed pod made of translucent green fiber that pulses with kinetic energy, acting as a magnetic anchor for its kin.

entries.name: 樱桃战神之壳
entries.flavor: 由坚硬的樱桃果核与不朽的金属编织而成，象征着前排战神那不可撼动的意志与一体的防御阵列。

entries.name: Century's Verdant Ember
entries.flavor: A dense, petrified jungle vine, perpetually smoldering with deep crimson heat.

entries.name: Obsidian Monolith
entries.flavor: A heavy, unyielding slab of volcanic glass that anchors the lineage to the very foundations of the world.

entries.name: Siphon Husk
entries.flavor: A hollowed, vine-choked gourd that pulses with a rhythmic, stolen heartbeat.

entries.name: 世界の王冠
entries.flavor: A miniature, polished orb of obsidian that reflects the entire horizon, held by a tiny, elegant silver stem.

entries.name: The Unquestionable Gift
entries.flavor: A porcelain doll's hand, frozen in a gesture of eager offering, clutching a velvet ribbon that never unravels.

entries.name: Imperial Fruit of the Undead
entries.flavor: A pulsating, dark-red fruit encased in a heavy, bowling-ball-like shell of calcified ash. It continuously exudes a thick, necrotic nectar that forces rapid, unnatural growth in anything it touches.

entries.name: Obsidian Subspecies Shell
entries.flavor: A dense, unyielding shard of volcanic glass that forms a protective layer around the core, shielding the heat within.

entries.name: Ascension Core
entries.flavor: A blindingly bright, polished cockpit module forged from scrap metal, designed to launch into the sky.

entries.name: Alpha Legion Vanguard
entries.flavor: A heavy, interlocking slab of dark tungsten-alloy, shaped like a tactical chevron, pulsing with the rhythmic cadence of a marching army.

entries.name: Corporate Sphere of Protection
entries.flavor: A heavy, polished black bowling ball etched with a corporate logo, pulsing with the necrotic energy of a thousand undead employees.

entries.name: 埃德加的儒雅讲义
entries.flavor: A polished mahogany lectern fragment, etched with complex equations that seem to shift when viewed from the corner of one's eye.

entries.name: Subspecies Core
entries.flavor: A translucent, frost-etched vessel containing a fragment of frozen essence, pulsing with a rhythmic chill.

entries.name: Obsidian Nut Shell
entries.flavor: A dense, jagged kernel of volcanic glass encased in a petrified, tuberous husk.

entries.name: Lunar Cabbage Core
entries.flavor: A dense, layered sphere of bioluminescent cabbage leaves, pulsing with the rhythmic glow of a dying moon.

entries.name: 盛鋼蓮之寒枝
entries.flavor: A frozen sprig of steel-hardened spruce, perpetually dusted with a layer of crystalline frost that never melts.

entries.name: 光錐の残滓
entries.flavor: A glowing, translucent cone of solidified sunlight, pulsing with the restless energy of a thousand suns, yet cold as a grave.

entries.name: Obsidian Husk
entries.flavor: A dense, jagged shell of volcanic glass that refuses to crack under pressure.

entries.name: Trident of the Low Resonance
entries.flavor: A heavy, three-pronged iron relic that vibrates with a deep, subsonic hum, reinforcing the resolve of those standing behind it.

entries.name: Verdant Bungee Canopy
entries.flavor: A heavy, woven umbrella of thick, necrotic leaves that drops its shade like a weighted vine.

entries.name: Umbrella Canopy
entries.flavor: A wide, leafy canopy of reinforced cellulose and thick veins, shaped like a protective dome to shelter those beneath its shade.

entries.name: Seasonal Sprout-Core
entries.flavor: A pulsating, fibrous knot of intertwined barley stalks and living loam that rhythmically expands and contracts like a lung.

entries.name: The Veteran's Scrimmage
entries.flavor: A weathered, deflated leather ball, stitched with sinew and stained by the dirt of a thousand forgotten seasons, representing the grit of a career spent on the field.

entries.name: The Prepared Relic
entries.flavor: A heavy, pre-assembled slab of fossilized muscle and iron, worn by those who find comfort in the repetitive rhythm of the march.

entries.name: Doctor's Bent Automaton
entries.flavor: A heavy, brass-plated mechanical torso, perpetually bowed in a gesture of academic reverence, housing a core of ticking clockwork.

entries.name: Doctor's Triumphant Relic
entries.flavor: A heavy, tarnished trophy forged from the remains of fallen kings, reclaimed from the depths of the laboratory.

entries.name: World-Frost Bastion
entries.flavor: A heavy, unyielding slab of permafrost that turns a battlefield into a frozen sanctuary.

entries.name: Trifolium Gourd
entries.flavor: A heavy, three-leafed pumpkin carved from living vine, pulsing with a rhythmic, generative glow.

entries.name: Iron-Clad Newsstand
entries.flavor: A heavy, rusted metal cart filled with endless newspapers and kernels of corn, providing a sturdy barricade for those who seek shelter within its iron walls.

entries.name: Rooted Iron-Bark
entries.flavor: A dense, metallic vine that weaves through the gaps in iron plating, fusing organic life with unyielding metal.

entries.name: The Unsinkable Iron Ring
entries.flavor: A heavy, rusted iron bucket shaped like a lifebuoy, floating aimlessly through the mire.

entries.name: Chlorophyll Canopy
entries.flavor: A floating, translucent leaf-membrane that drifts above the unit, casting a protective shade of verdant energy.

entries.name: Cabbage-Core Husk
entries.flavor: A dense, layered sphere of fibrous vegetable matter that absorbs impact only to snap back with equal force.

entries.name: Jade-Spire Volley
entries.flavor: A jagged spire of emerald-hued obsidian, this entity is a living needle forged from calcified desert grit and concentrated solar heat.

entries.name: Spore-Cloud Spore-Cap
entries.flavor: A dense, porous fungal cap that constantly exhales a thick, corrosive smog from its gills.

entries.name: Verdant Thistle-Spike
entries.flavor: A cluster of calcified aquatic weeds, sharpened into jagged needles that pulse with a rhythmic, stinging vitality.

entries.name: Iron-Rimmed Hoop-Core
entries.flavor: A heavy, dented metal ring filled with dense, necrotic sludge that pulses with the momentum of a thousand failed shots.

entries.name: 绒毛丧尸群
entries.flavor: 由无数团绒绒的、带着腐朽气息的草茎组成的乌合之众，它们在感知到威胁时会集体蠕动，形成一种难以捉摸的应对姿态。

entries.name: Gorged Pitfall Core
entries.flavor: A pulsating, cherry-red bulb that rhythmically expands and contracts like a hungry throat, smelling faintly of rot and gunpowder.

entries.name: Cherry-Burst Spore-Core
entries.flavor: A gelatinous, crimson sphere that pulses with volatile energy, designed to absorb kinetic impact and detonate upon contact.

entries.name: Broadsheet Monologue
entries.flavor: A jagged collage of pulpy, cherry-red newsprint that crinkles rhythmically, performing a silent, tragic solo.
